title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices (January 2027 data) — the 9:00 a.m. ET co-tenant of the FHFA HPI morning
source: NEWS: S&P Dow Jones Indices' own press release for the June-2026 edition, press.spglobal.com/2026-08-25-S-P-Cotality-Case-Shiller-Index-Reports-Annual-Gain-in-June-2026, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 90,693 bytes), which states the standing schedule verbatim: "The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Indices are published on the last Tuesday of each month at 9:00 am ET." Its own publication date, 2026-08-25, IS the last Tuesday of August 2026, anchoring the rule against a realized 2026 print rather than the sentence alone. Corroborated by the publisher's own news-release archive (press.spglobal.com/index.php?s=2429&mode=list, two keyword passes, HTTP 200, 82,810 and 83,085 bytes, same fetch): NINE dated Case-Shiller releases are listed and all nine fell on that month's last Tuesday — 2025-08-26, 2025-09-30, 2026-01-27, 2026-02-24, 2026-04-28, 2026-05-26, 2026-06-30, 2026-07-28, 2026-08-25. Independently reproduced by weekday arithmetic: March 2027's Tuesdays are the 2nd, 9th, 16th, 23rd and 30th, so 2027-03-30 is the last. Filed estimate on three honest counts, none of which is date doubt. (1) The confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index provider's own standing publication rule — the same taxonomy gap every S&P DJI and Russell entry in this calendar records. (2) This lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. (3) THE CADENCE HAS SLIPPED ONCE INSIDE THE VERIFIED SAMPLE AND IT IS STATED RATHER THAN DRESSED UP: there is NO Case-Shiller release in March 2026 on that archive, and the two releases bracketing the gap are 2026-02-24 (December-2025 data) and 2026-04-28 (January-2026 data) — a nine-week gap that the next release, 2026-05-26 (March-2026 data), closed. This proposer read the 2026-04-28 release in full (HTTP 200, 95,278 bytes) and found ZERO occurrences of "February", so the pending-home-sales-2026-10-20 proposal's characterisation that it published "alongside the February-2026-data report" is not what the document says; corrected here rather than inherited. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30 initial research (2026-09-08, D-568) and load-bearing for it rather than incidental. THE FINDING THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO PUT ON THE CALENDAR: the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 lane built a 09:00-09:30 ET pre-market window and tabulated that hour as carrying "the FHFA release, and nothing else scheduled"; seven FHFA ledgers now lean on it. Case-Shiller publishes at the SAME MINUTE on the SAME last-Tuesday rule, is a home-price index like FHFA's, and is the more market-followed of the two — so the window is not FHFA-only and never was. Nine verified Case-Shiller dates, nine FHFA release dates, nine matches. THE CALENDAR CURRENTLY TRACKS ZERO CANONICAL CASE-SHILLER ENTRIES: two sibling sweeps proposed case-shiller-hpi-2026-10-27 on 2026-09-08 (from pending-home-sales-2026-10-20 and from nar-metro-home-prices-2026-10-29) and neither has been taken up, so the most-cited US repeat-sales home-price index is absent from a calendar carrying seven other housing series. This proposal is for the edition inside the proposer's own corridor and does not backfill the series; whichever lane takes 2026-10-27 first should promote from the publisher's own forward schedule if it can reach it — spglobal.com/spdji index-announcement pages returned HTTP 403 to the 10-20 lane's runner and were not retried here. TWO-MONTH LAG, SO JANUARY 2027 DATA: the same release states the reporting lag, and the realized 2026 titles track it (2026-08-25 -> June 2026). That makes this edition and fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30 the SAME reference month on the SAME morning at the SAME minute, which is the attribution hazard in its sharpest form. Impact low and symbols: [] on the same measured basis as every sibling housing entry: no house playbook in docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md or docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md is macro- or housing-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-08). An estimate widens caution; nothing here licenses an entry.
